entries.text: ClickHouse local mode (chDB) no longer turns NULL into NaN in query results, and now receives results as Arrow by default; set the fetch_mode platform option to rows to switch back.
details: The rows path converted the Arrow result through pandas, so a NULL float (TPC-H Q17 at scale factor 0.01, an empty aggregate) became NaN and its result digest differed from the Arrow path; NULLs in integer columns also became floats. Rows are now built directly from the Arrow table.
Rows and Arrow produced identical result digests for all 22 TPC-H queries at scale factor 0.01 on chDB 3.7.2; ClickHouse server and cloud stay on rows.
